name: f03_compact
notes: A focus-less save returns the compact frame: tick, at, store, resolution, writes, near_matches, conflicts, template_drift only (spec §7). 'merged': [] included per pin §3.14 despite the §7 example omitting it — see README contradictions. Ids reconciled at M2: seeds are 0-based, #0-#31/rel:0-rel:9 (README assumptions 2-3); first user mint #32, first user relation rel:10; instance_of relations are never listed in minted_relations (assumption 5).

steps.notes: minted_elements in first-touch payload-walk order (pin §3.17): elements[0].name, elements[0].kind, facts[0].s, facts[0].p (attribute-name mint, audit-listed); facts[0].o re-touches #32, not a reuse. rel:10 = the uses fact; the instance_of relation takes rel:11 silently.
